title: Resend rollback conflates 0-row (concurrent state change) with success; retry form strands referee on 404
detail: If a takeover/status change lands during the send window, restore_form_token's guard yields 0 rows. `Ok(_) -> Nil` ignores this, so view_resend_failed(token: old_token) renders a retry whose old_token is now dead (form_token stayed new_token); the retry's lookup 404s instead of showing landlord-handling.
recommended_fix: Match `Ok(pog.Returned(_, []))` separately in rollback_remint; on 0 rows the state moved under the referee, so re-classify and render the truthful state page instead of the resend-failed retry form.
